doc.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Marrying his high school sweetheart
summary: He married the girl he had met in school, who was his only girlfriend; Jack Kelso was best man and Nat King Cole played at the reception.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Anyway this takes me up to -- I’m playing LA. I get married.
Okay, you were 16 last time we talked about leaving. Then you went out and started –
I come back. I was 19 years old when I came back.
So you actually left LA then. You were doing touring?
I was just working all over but more or less on the west coast. It was all west coast stuff. And I got married, right.
At what age, and where, and to whom?
I got married in LA and we had to get permission to get married because I got drafted.
What age are we talking about now? So you must be 18 if you were drafted.
I would be 19, 20.
Okay, I’m trying to get the chronology because you left high school, then you said you came back. So you came back, you re-enrolled in high school to finish up.
Right.
So if you were 16, maybe junior, senior year, so you had at least a year to finish up?
Yes.
So you came back after -- now you’re a professional musician up and down the coast playing. You come back to LA and you’re 19, so that’s over two years gone.
Yeah.
So now you’re back in LA, you come home and you get married. So is this somebody that you’ve known for a while?
My wife.
Yeah, but we don’t -- she’s not in any of the pictures. You said you met her at 13.

Yeah, well when I started back to school we had a class together. It was either a math class or some kind of class. We had a class and we got to be friends, and she was the only girlfriend I ever had.
You start at the top. You can’t go anywhere else.
And it sounds funny -- it’s not funny, but you know who played at my wedding? Nat.
Nat King Cole?
Yeah. MR. BROLWN: He played for the wedding reception. That’s an (unintelligible).
Yeah, when we got married, Jack was my best man. You know, to make a long story short, after the wedding I did get drafted and man they sent me to Fort McLellan, Alabama.
